sentences.zh: 十一年，偕道員金國琛會攻德安，先克孝感，復會水陸軍圍攻德安，克之，加都統銜。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he joined circuit intendant Jin Guochen in a joint attack on De'an, first captured Xiaogan, then joined land and river forces in besieging De'an and took it; he was given the nominal rank of commandant-general.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he and Circuit Intendant Jin Guochen attacked De'an, took Xiaogan first, then with combined land and river forces besieged and captured De'an; he received the nominal rank of commandant-general.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，授護軍統領。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi he was appointed commander of the Guard Corps.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tongzhi (1862) he was made commander of the Guard Corps.

sentences.zh: 粵、捻諸匪分兩路竄湖北，總兵穆正春擊其西路，舒保擊其東路，連敗之於黃陂、廣濟、應山，賊竄回豫境，賜黃馬褂。

translations.literal: Cantonese and Nian bandits split into two routes and fled into Hubei; brigade general Mu Zhengchun struck their western route and Shubao their eastern route, repeatedly defeating them at Huangpi, Guangji, and Yingshan; the bandits fled back into Henan territory; he was granted a yellow riding jacket.
translations.idiomatic: Taiping and Nian rebels split into two columns and raided Hubei; Brigadier Mu Zhengchun hit the western column and Shubao the eastern, routing them at Huangpi, Guangji, and Yingshan; when the rebels fled back into Henan he was awarded a yellow riding jacket.

sentences.zh: 賊復回應山，撲孝感城，舒保啟南門奮擊，賊已卻，突別賊數千潛由北城入，副都統德克登額、署知縣韓體震等死之。

translations.literal: The bandits returned to Yingshan and rushed at Xiaogan city; Shubao opened the south gate and fought fiercely; the bandits had already withdrawn when suddenly several thousand other bandits secretly entered through the north wall; vice commandant Dekedenge, acting magistrate Han Tizhen, and others died.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels returned to Yingshan and stormed Xiaogan; Shubao sallied from the south gate and drove them off, but thousands of another band slipped in through the north wall; Vice Commandant Dekedenge, Acting Magistrate Han Tizhen, and others were killed.

sentences.zh: 舒保還戰城中，賊复敗逸，追殺三十餘裡。

translations.literal: Shubao turned back to fight in the city; the bandits were again defeated and fled; pursuit and killing extended more than thirty li.
translations.idiomatic: Shubao fought on inside the city, routed the rebels again, and pursued them for more than thirty li.

sentences.zh: 二年，賊由應城圖襲漢口，為官軍所卻。

translations.literal: In the second year bandits from Yingcheng plotted to raid Hankou and were repulsed by government troops.
translations.idiomatic: The next year rebels from Yingcheng tried to strike Hankou and were driven off by government forces.

sentences.zh: 轉撲孝感，舒保迭戰李家灣、倉子埠，陣斬老捻千餘，遂引去，被珍賚。

translations.literal: They turned to rush at Xiaogan; Shubao fought successive battles at Lijiawan and Cangzibu, slaying more than a thousand veteran Nian on the field; they then withdrew; he received lavish rewards.
translations.idiomatic: They then turned on Xiaogan; Shubao fought at Lijiawan and Cangzibu and killed more than a thousand veteran Nian in battle; the rebels withdrew and he was richly rewarded.

sentences.zh: 三年，擊捻匪於德安西，追抵壽山，日暮，層岡深澗，不利騎戰，賊來益眾，舒保陷重圍中，越坎落馬，力竭陣亡，贈太子少保，予騎都尉兼雲騎尉世職，入祀昭忠祠，湖北建專祠，諡貞恪。

translations.literal: In the third year he attacked Nian bandits west of De'an and pursued to Shoushan; at dusk, amid layered hills and deep ravines unfavorable to cavalry combat, the bandits came in ever greater numbers; Shubao fell into heavy encirclement, crossed a ridge and fell from his horse, exhausted his strength and died on the field; he was posthumously granted Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, granted the hereditary offices of Master Commandant of Cavalry and Junior Cloud Commandant, entered the worship at the Temple of Loyalty and Fidelity, a special shrine was built in Hubei, posthumous title Zhenke.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he fought Nian rebels west of De'an and pursued them to Shoushan; at dusk, on broken ridges and in deep ravines ill suited to cavalry, the enemy swelled around him; trapped in heavy encirclement, Shubao cleared a ridge, was thrown from his horse, and died fighting; he was posthumously made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, granted hereditary Master Commandant of Cavalry and Junior Cloud Commandant, enshrined in the Temple of Loyal Loyalty, given a private shrine in Hubei, and honored with the posthumous name Zhenke.

sentences.zh: 伊興額，原名伊清阿，字松坪，何圖哩氏，蒙古正白旗人，吉林駐防。

translations.literal: Yixing'e, original name Yiqing'a, style name Songping, of the Hetu'ri clan, a Mongol of the Plain White Banner, garrisoned at Jilin.
translations.idiomatic: Yixing'e, originally named Yiqing'a and styled Songping, belonged to the Hetu'ri clan; he was a Mongol bannerman of the Plain White Banner garrisoned at Jilin.

sentences.zh: 從征喀什噶爾，除驍騎校，選授侍衛。

translations.literal: He followed the campaign against Kashgar, was appointed a vanguard commandant, and was selected and appointed a bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: He served in the Kashgar campaign, was made a vanguard commandant, and was selected for appointment as a bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 入京召對，宣宗以原名不合清語，命改名伊興額。

translations.literal: Called to audience upon entering the capital, the Daoguang Emperor, because the original name did not conform to Manchu speech, ordered that his name be changed to Yixing'e.
translations.idiomatic: Summoned to audience in the capital, the Daoguang Emperor ruled that his original name was not proper Manchu and renamed him Yixing'e.

sentences.zh: 道光十九年，擢三等侍衛，改隸滿洲。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year of Daoguang he was promoted to third-class bodyguard and transferred to Manchu affiliation.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year of Daoguang (1839) he was promoted to third-class bodyguard and transferred to Manchu registration.

sentences.zh: 咸豐三年，自請從軍，發揚州大營。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xianfeng he volunteered for military service and was dispatched from the Grand Camp at Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Xianfeng (1853) he volunteered for active service and was sent from the Yangzhou headquarters.

sentences.zh: 琦善令援江浦，初至，示弱不戰，斫賊營，大敗之柳樹壩，破九洑洲，累擢頭等侍衛。

translations.literal: Qi Shan ordered him to reinforce Jiangpu; when he first arrived he feigned weakness and did not fight, then stormed the bandit camp and greatly defeated them at Liushuba, broke Jiufuzhou, and was repeatedly promoted to first-class bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: Qi Shan ordered him to reinforce Jiangpu; he first feigned weakness, then struck the rebel camp, routed them at Liushuba, took Jiufuzhou, and was promoted to first-class bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 賊圍和州急，伊興額不待令，督軍進擊，解其圍。

translations.literal: When bandits urgently besieged Hezhou, Yixing'e without awaiting orders supervised the army in advancing to attack and lifted the siege.
translations.idiomatic: When rebels tightly besieged Hezhou, Yixing'e attacked without waiting for orders and relieved the city.

sentences.zh: 駐江浦三年。

translations.literal: He was garrisoned at Jiangpu for three years.
translations.idiomatic: He remained garrisoned at Jiangpu for three years.

sentences.zh: 六年，剿捻匪夏白、任仲勉於澮河北岸，殲賊二千餘，仲勉斃於陣。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he suppressed Nian bandits Xia Bai and Ren Zhongmian on the north bank of the Hui River, annihilated more than two thousand bandits, and Zhongmian was killed on the field.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he fought Nian leaders Xia Bai and Ren Zhongmian on the north bank of the Hui River, killed more than two thousand rebels, and Zhongmian fell in battle.

sentences.zh: 夏白糾雉河賊黨圍宿州，伊興額率千騎往援，四戰皆捷，解其圍。

translations.literal: Xia Bai rallied Zhihe bandit partisans to besiege Suzhou; Yixing'e led a thousand cavalry to reinforce, won four battles in succession, and lifted the siege.
translations.idiomatic: Xia Bai gathered Zhihe rebels and besieged Suzhou; Yixing'e led a thousand horse to the relief, won four straight fights, and broke the siege.

sentences.zh: 分軍防徐州、宿州，張洛行來犯，偕總兵傅振邦擊走之。

translations.literal: He divided his army to guard Xuzhou and Suzhou; when Zhang Luoxing came to invade, together with brigade general Fu Zhenbang he attacked and drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: He posted detachments to guard Xuzhou and Suzhou; when Zhang Luoxing attacked, he and Brigadier Fu Zhenbang drove him off.

sentences.zh: 時潁、亳、蒙、宿諸捻蜂起，徐、宿百里內宴然，耕穫不輟。

translations.literal: At that time Nian bandits rose like bees in Ying, Bo, Meng, and Su regions; within a hundred li of Xu and Su all was tranquil and sowing and reaping did not cease.
translations.idiomatic: While Nian rebels swarmed across Ying, Bo, Meng, and Su, the hundred li around Xuzhou and Suzhou stayed quiet and farmers kept harvesting.

sentences.zh: 賊首王廣愛、梁振貴眾數万聚張七家樓，圖北竄。

translations.literal: Bandit chiefs Wang Guang'ai and Liang Zhengui gathered a force of tens of thousands at Zhangqijialou, planning to flee north.
translations.idiomatic: Rebel leaders Wang Guang'ai and Liang Zhengui mustered tens of thousands at Zhangqijialou and planned to break north.

sentences.zh: 伊興額選精銳數百，疾馳掩入賊壘，擒王、梁二賊，賊黨來援，擊走之，以副都統記名，賜花翎。

translations.literal: Yixing'e selected several hundred elite troops, galloped swiftly to strike into the bandit stockade, captured the two bandits Wang and Liang; when bandit partisans came to reinforce he attacked and drove them off; he was entered on the list for vice commandant-general and granted the peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: Yixing'e took several hundred picked troops, stormed the rebel stronghold, and captured Wang and Liang; when reinforcements came he beat them back, was noted for vice commandant-general, and received the peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 七年，招降王家墟捻黨陳保元五千人，斬其渠李月，賜號額圖渾巴圖魯。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he induced the Wangjiaxu Nian partisans under Chen Baoyuan, five thousand men, to surrender, beheaded their chief Li Yue, and was granted the title Etuhun Batuer.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he induced five thousand Nian under Chen Baoyuan at Wangjiaxu to surrender, executed their leader Li Yue, and received the title Etuhun Batuer.

sentences.zh: 因病回徐州，勝保劾其不遵調度，報捷不實，褫翎頂。

translations.literal: Because of illness he returned to Xuzhou; Sheng Bao impeached him for failing to obey command and reporting victories falsely; his feather and rank button were stripped.
translations.idiomatic: He returned to Xuzhou on sick leave; Sheng Bao accused him of disobeying orders and fabricating victory reports, and his peacock feather and rank button were removed.

sentences.zh: 尋率馬隊攻喬家廟，擒斬捻首梁思住，夜進攻酆家墟，誅賊渠劉大淵，偕總兵史榮椿破賊趙家屯。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward he led cavalry to attack Qiaojiamiao, captured and beheaded Nian chief Liang Sizhu; at night he advanced to attack Fengjiaxu and executed bandit chief Liu Dayuan; together with brigade general Shi Rongchun he broke the bandits at Zhaojiatun.
translations.idiomatic: He soon led cavalry against Qiaojiamiao, captured and executed Nian chief Liang Sizhu, struck Fengjiaxu by night and killed rebel chief Liu Dayuan, and with Brigadier Shi Rongchun routed the enemy at Zhaojiatun.

sentences.zh: 渦河兩岸肅清，复翎頂。

translations.literal: Both banks of the Wo River were cleared; his feather and rank button were restored.
translations.idiomatic: Both banks of the Wo River were pacified and his peacock feather and rank button were restored.

sentences.zh: 八年，授正紅旗蒙古副都統。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was appointed vice commandant-general of the Mongol Plain Red Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he was made vice commandant-general of the Mongol Plain Red Banner.

sentences.zh: 破捻匪於紀家莊，解蒙城圍。

translations.literal: He defeated Nian bandits at Jijiazhuang and lifted the siege of Mengcheng.
translations.idiomatic: He defeated Nian rebels at Jijiazhuang and relieved Mengcheng.

sentences.zh: 攻薛家湖賊巢，砲傷股，裹創力戰，毀其墟，加頭品頂戴。

translations.literal: Attacking the bandit nest at Xuejiahu he was wounded in the thigh by cannon fire, wrapped his wound and fought on strenuously, destroyed their stockade, and was given the first-rank cap button.
translations.idiomatic: Storming the rebel nest at Xuejiahu he was hit in the thigh by artillery, bound his wound and fought on, destroyed the stronghold, and received the first-rank cap button.

sentences.zh: 尋捻首劉添祥由六安北竄，眾號數万，伊興額以孤軍無援，退屯蕭縣。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward Nian chief Liu Tianxiang fled north from Lu'an with a force claimed to number tens of thousands; Yixing'e, being an isolated army without reinforcement, withdrew and encamped at Xiaoxian.
translations.idiomatic: When Nian chief Liu Tianxiang broke north from Lu'an with a force said to number in the tens of thousands, Yixing'e, unsupported and alone, fell back to Xiaoxian.

sentences.zh: 賊陷豐縣，坐奪職。

translations.literal: The bandits captured Fengxian; as a consequence his office was stripped.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels took Fengxian and he was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 九年春，起佐傅振邦剿捻，接統袁甲三所部兵，詔復職，督辦河南軍事。

translations.literal: In the spring of the ninth year he was reinstated to assist Fu Zhenbang in suppressing the Nian, took over command of Yuan Jiasan's troops, was ordered restored to office, and was put in charge of Henan military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the ninth year he was reinstated to aid Fu Zhenbang against the Nian, assumed command of Yuan Jiasan's troops, was restored to office, and put in charge of Henan military affairs.

sentences.zh: 伊興額率騎千三百赴援，躡賊商水老湖坡。

translations.literal: Yixing'e led thirteen hundred cavalry to reinforce, pursuing the bandits to Laohupo in Shangshui.
translations.idiomatic: Yixing'e led thirteen hundred horse to the relief and tracked the rebels to Laohupo in Shangshui.

sentences.zh: 賊眾數倍，列車陣拒戰，潛分兵繞賊後夾擊之，賊潰走，窮追三晝夜，歷沈丘、項城至太和孫家圩，先後斃賊二萬餘，被旨嘉獎。

translations.literal: The bandits were several times more numerous and deployed in wagon formations to resist battle; he secretly divided troops to circle behind the bandits and strike from both sides; the bandits broke and fled; pursuit for three days and nights passed through Shenqiu and Xiangcheng to Sunjiawei in Taihe; more than twenty thousand bandits were killed in succession; he received an imperial commendation.
translations.idiomatic: Outnumbered several times over, the rebels formed wagon defenses; he split his force to circle behind them and attacked from both sides; the enemy broke and fled; a three-day pursuit through Shenqiu and Xiangcheng to Sunjiawei in Taihe killed more than twenty thousand; the court praised him by decree.

sentences.zh: 時總兵邱聯恩戰歿舞陽，舞陽去商水二百里，及戰勝，舞陽賊聞風遁。

translations.literal: At that time brigade general Qiu Lian'en fell in battle at Wuyang; Wuyang was two hundred li from Shangshui; by the time of the victory the Wuyang bandits fled at the news.
translations.idiomatic: Brigadier Qiu Lian'en had just been killed at Wuyang, two hundred li from Shangshui; when news of Yixing'e's victory spread, the Wuyang rebels fled.

sentences.zh: 勝保復奏劾：「伊興額性情乖僻，商水之役，僅擊退別股，並未迎剿。

translations.literal: Sheng Bao again memorialized impeachment: "Yixing'e's temperament is perverse and difficult; in the battle at Shangshui he only drove off a separate band and did not meet and suppress the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng Bao again impeached him: "Yixing'e is willful and difficult; at Shangshui he only repulsed a separate column and failed to meet the main force.

sentences.zh: 舞陽賊眾僅六千，而疏報輒稱二萬三千。

translations.literal: The Wuyang bandits numbered only six thousand, yet in memorial reports he repeatedly claimed twenty-three thousand.
translations.idiomatic: The Wuyang rebels numbered only six thousand, yet his reports claimed twenty-three thousand.

sentences.zh: 」詔奪頭品頂戴，交勝保差遣。

translations.literal: " The emperor ordered stripping of the first-rank cap button and placed him under Sheng Bao's assignment.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor stripped his first-rank cap button and placed him under Sheng Bao's command.

sentences.zh: 所請獎老湖坡戰勝員弁，下署漕督袁甲三察奏。

translations.literal: The officers and men he requested rewarded for the victory at Laohupo were referred to Acting Grain Transport Governor Yuan Jiasan for investigation and memorial.
translations.idiomatic: His request to reward the officers who fought at Laohupo was referred to Acting Grain Transport Governor Yuan Jiasan for review.

sentences.zh: 伊興額遂謝病回徐州，距復起僅三月。

translations.literal: Yixing'e then pleaded illness and returned to Xuzhou, only three months from his reinstatement.
translations.idiomatic: Yixing'e then resigned on grounds of illness and returned to Xuzhou, only three months after his reinstatement.

sentences.zh: 尋詔飭赴甲三營勦賊，稱疾不赴。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward an edict ordered him sternly to go to Jiasan's camp to suppress bandits; he claimed illness and did not go.
translations.idiomatic: Soon an edict ordered him to Jiasan's camp to fight rebels; he pleaded illness and refused.

sentences.zh: 蕭縣民鄭立本等以伊興額去，賊复熾，叩閽請還鎮。

translations.literal: The people of Xiaoxian, Zheng Liben and others, because Yixing'e had departed and bandits again flourished, knocked at the palace gate requesting his return to garrison.
translations.idiomatic: When Yixing'e left, rebels resurged in Xiaoxian; Zheng Liben and others petitioned at court to have him return.

sentences.zh: 德楞額复代奏：「徐州紳民以伊興額在徐養病，請飭就近治軍。

translations.literal: Deleng'e again memorialized on their behalf: "The gentry and people of Xuzhou, because Yixing'e is nursing illness at Xu, request that he be ordered to command troops nearby.
translations.idiomatic: Deleng'e memorialized again: "Xuzhou gentry and commoners ask that Yixing'e, recuperating there, be ordered to command troops locally.

sentences.zh: 」先後諭詢伊興額病狀，伊興額固以篤疾辭，上怒，褫職，勒令回旗。

translations.literal: " The throne repeatedly inquired about Yixing'e's illness; Yixing'e firmly pleaded grave sickness and declined; the emperor was angered, stripped his office, and ordered him compelled to return to his banner.
translations.idiomatic: " The throne repeatedly asked after his health; Yixing'e insisted he was gravely ill; the emperor grew angry, dismissed him, and ordered him back to his banner.

sentences.zh: 都察院奏上安徽監生張鴻文呈，言伊興額前功，懇令總辦討賊事宜，不報。

translations.literal: The Censorate memorialized submitting the petition of Anhui licentiate Zhang Hongwen, speaking of Yixing'e's former merit and earnestly requesting that he be put in overall charge of bandit-suppression affairs; no response was given.
translations.idiomatic: The Censorate forwarded a petition from Anhui licentiate Zhang Hongwen praising Yixing'e's past service and asking that he be put in overall charge of anti-rebel operations; it went unanswered.

sentences.zh: 十年，僧格林沁疏薦，予六品頂戴，尋加三品，敕辦徐、宿團練。

translations.literal: In the tenth year Sengge Rinchen memorialized recommending him; he was granted a sixth-rank cap button, soon increased to third rank, and ordered to manage militia organization in Xu and Su.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year Sengge Rinchen recommended him; he received a sixth-rank cap button, soon a third-rank one, and was ordered to organize militia in Xuzhou and Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 伊興額再起，其舊部多不隸麾下，所將五百騎未及訓練，以賊竄曹州，僧格林沁趣援。

translations.literal: When Yixing'e rose again, many of his old subordinates no longer served under his command; the five hundred cavalry he led had not yet been trained; because bandits fled into Caozhou, Sengge Rinchen urgently ordered reinforcement.
translations.idiomatic: When Yixing'e returned to service, most of his old troops no longer answered to him; his five hundred horse were barely trained when rebels raided Caozhou and Sengge Rinchen ordered him to reinforce.

sentences.zh: 十一年春，偕徐州鎮總兵滕家勝率騎二千馳往，擊賊於東平、汶上，累捷。

translations.literal: In the spring of the eleventh year, together with Xuzhou garrison brigade general Teng Jiasheng he led two thousand cavalry in haste; they attacked bandits at Dongping and Wenshang and won repeated victories.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the eleventh year he and Xuzhou Garrison Brigadier Teng Jiasheng led two thousand horse to Dongping and Wenshang and won a series of victories.

sentences.zh: 追至臥虎岡，風霾忽作，急退楊柳集。

translations.literal: Pursuit reached Wohugang; sudden wind and haze arose; they hurriedly withdrew to Yangliuji.
translations.idiomatic: Pursuit reached Wohugang; a sudden sandstorm blew up and they fell back hastily to Yangliuji.

sentences.zh: 伏起，家勝馬躓，歿於陣。

translations.literal: An ambush rose; Jiasheng's horse stumbled and he died on the field.
translations.idiomatic: Ambushers sprang up; Jiasheng's horse stumbled and he was killed in battle.

sentences.zh: 伊興額揮百餘騎衝入賊中，索之不得，突圍出，從騎僅隨者十餘人，賊圍之數匝，力竭死之。

translations.literal: Yixing'e wielded a little more than a hundred cavalry and charged into the bandits, searched but could not find him, broke out of encirclement; of the accompanying cavalry only a little more than ten followed; the bandits surrounded him in several rings; strength exhausted, he died.
translations.idiomatic: Yixing'e charged into the enemy with a little over a hundred horse to find Jiasheng, broke out with only a dozen riders still with him, was surrounded many times over, and died when his strength gave out.

sentences.zh: 詔復原官，予騎都尉世職，諡壯愍，建祠徐州、汶上、宿州、永城。

translations.literal: An edict restored his original office, granted the hereditary office of Master Commandant of Cavalry, posthumous title Zhuangmin, and temples were built at Xuzhou, Wenshang, Suzhou, and Yongcheng.
translations.idiomatic: The court restored his rank, granted a hereditary Master Commandant of Cavalry, posthumously named him Zhuangmin, and built memorial shrines at Xuzhou, Wenshang, Suzhou, and Yongcheng.

sentences.zh: 滕家勝，湖南乾州廳人。

translations.literal: Teng Jiasheng, a native of Qianzhou Subprefecture in Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: Teng Jiasheng was a native of Qianzhou Subprefecture in Hunan.

sentences.zh: 由行伍從江忠源勦賊湖北，累擢游擊。

translations.literal: From the ranks he followed Jiang Zhongyuan in suppressing bandits in Hubei and was repeatedly promoted to colonel.
translations.idiomatic: Enlisting as a common soldier, he followed Jiang Zhongyuan against rebels in Hubei and rose to colonel.

sentences.zh: 繼從袁甲三剿捻於皖、豫之間，擢參將，賜號伊博格巴圖魯。

translations.literal: He then followed Yuan Jiasan in suppressing the Nian between Anhui and Henan, was promoted to brigadier, and was granted the title Aibojia Batuer.
translations.idiomatic: He then served under Yuan Jiasan against the Nian in Anhui and Henan, was made brigadier, and received the title Aibojia Batuer.

sentences.zh: 勝保薦其少年勇敢，超授四川川北鎮總兵，調徐州鎮，幫辦徐、宿軍務。

translations.literal: Sheng Bao recommended his youth and bravery; he was exceptionally appointed brigade general of the northern Sichuan garrison, transferred to the Xuzhou garrison, and assisted in Xu and Su military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng Bao praised his youth and courage; he was specially made brigade general of the northern Sichuan garrison, transferred to Xuzhou, and assigned to assist in regional military affairs.

sentences.zh: 家勝舊隸伊興額部下，至是同戰歿，贈提督，予騎都尉並云騎尉世職，諡武烈。

translations.literal: Jiasheng had formerly served under Yixing'e; when they fought together he too died on the field; he was posthumously granted provincial commander-in-chief, granted the hereditary offices of Master Commandant of Cavalry and Junior Cloud Commandant, posthumous title Wulie.
translations.idiomatic: Jiasheng had once served under Yixing'e; he fell beside him in the same battle; posthumously made provincial commander-in-chief, granted hereditary Master Commandant of Cavalry and Junior Cloud Commandant, and honored as Wulie.

sentences.zh: 關保，烏扎拉氏，滿洲正黃旗人，吉林駐防。

translations.literal: Guanbao, of the Uzala clan, a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner, garrisoned at Jilin.
translations.idiomatic: Guanbao, of the Uzala clan, was a Manchu bannerman of the Plain Yellow Banner garrisoned at Jilin.

sentences.zh: 道光初，從征喀什噶爾有功，洊升三姓佐領。

translations.literal: In the early Daoguang period he followed the campaign against Kashgar with merit and was repeatedly promoted to company commander of Sanxing.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Daoguang era he served with distinction in the Kashgar campaign and rose to company commander at Sanxing.

sentences.zh: 咸豐三年，隨侍郎恩華剿粵匪，解懷慶圍，追敗之平陽，屯正定。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xianfeng he followed Vice Minister En Hua in suppressing Cantonese bandits, lifted the siege of Huaiqing, pursued and defeated them at Pingyang, and encamped at Zhengding.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Xianfeng he followed Vice Minister En Hua against the Taiping rebels, relieved Huaiqing, pursued and defeated them at Pingyang, and encamped at Zhengding.

sentences.zh: 勝保檄充營總，勦賊於深州、靜海，攻獨流鎮，擢協領。

translations.literal: Sheng Bao ordered him to serve as camp chief, suppressed bandits at Shenzhou and Jinghai, attacked Duliuzhen, and was promoted to battalion commander.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng Bao made him camp chief; he fought rebels at Shenzhou and Jinghai, attacked Duliuzhen, and was promoted to battalion commander.

sentences.zh: 四年，從僧格林沁戰阜城三里莊，槍傷額，奮擊破賊，賜號年昌阿巴圖魯。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he followed Sengge Rinchen in battle at Sanlizhuang, Fucheng; wounded in the forehead by gunfire, he fought fiercely and broke the bandits; he was granted the title Nianchang'a Batuer.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he fought with Sengge Rinchen at Sanlizhuang outside Fucheng; shot in the forehead, he pressed the attack and routed the enemy, earning the title Nianchang'a Batuer.

sentences.zh: 從勝保援臨清，追賊至豐縣，殲之，以總管升用。

translations.literal: He followed Sheng Bao to reinforce Linqing, pursued bandits to Fengxian and annihilated them; he was promoted for use as superintendent.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Sheng Bao to relieve Linqing, pursued the rebels to Fengxian and destroyed them, and was promoted to superintendent.

sentences.zh: 五年，從僧格林沁克馮官屯，從西凌阿赴湖北，尋調河南，又調安徽，從和春克廬州，加二品銜。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he followed Sengge Rinchen in capturing Fengguantun, followed Xi Ling'a to Hubei, was soon transferred to Henan, then to Anhui, followed He Chun in capturing Luzhou, and was given the nominal second rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he helped Sengge Rinchen take Fengguantun, went to Hubei with Xi Ling'a, was transferred to Henan and then Anhui, helped He Chun take Luzhou, and received nominal second rank.

sentences.zh: 六年，偕副都統麟瑞破賊五河，斃黃衣賊目二人，殲賊千餘，敗邳州援賊，解壽州圍。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, together with vice commandant Lin Rui he broke bandits at Wuhe, killed two yellow-clad bandit chiefs, annihilated more than a thousand bandits, defeated relief bandits from Pizhou, and lifted the siege of Shouzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he and Vice Commandant Lin Rui defeated rebels at Wuhe, killed two yellow-clad chiefs and more than a thousand men, beat off Pizhou reinforcements, and relieved Shouzhou.

sentences.zh: 擊賊潁上，五戰皆捷，所部馬隊，各省爭欲得之助剿。

translations.literal: He attacked bandits at Yingshang; five battles were all victorious; provinces all competed to obtain his cavalry detachment to assist in suppression.
translations.idiomatic: Fighting at Yingshang he won five straight victories; every province wanted his cavalry to help.

sentences.zh: 尋隸河南巡撫英桂軍，敗賊馬村橋，進亳州雙溝，遇賊姬橋，殲之。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward he was attached to Henan Governor Ying Gui's army, defeated bandits at Macunqiao, advanced to Shuanggou in Bozhou, encountered bandits at Jiqiao, and annihilated them.
translations.idiomatic: He then served under Henan Governor Ying Gui, defeated rebels at Macunqiao, advanced to Shuanggou in Bozhou, met them again at Jiqiao, and wiped them out.

sentences.zh: 又連敗賊三丈口、舊縣集，安徽巡撫福濟疏調赴蒙城，英桂仍請留河南，詔令和衷商榷，先赴所急。

translations.literal: He again repeatedly defeated bandits at Sanzhangkou and Jiuxianji; Anhui Governor Fu Ji memorialized requesting his transfer to Mengcheng; Ying Gui still asked to retain him in Henan; an edict ordered harmonious consultation and going first where the urgency was greatest.
translations.idiomatic: He then beat them at Sanzhangkou and Jiuxianji; Anhui Governor Fu Ji asked for him at Mengcheng while Ying Gui wanted him in Henan; the court told them to compromise and send him where need was greatest.

sentences.zh: 其冬，率軍趨懷遠，越境敗捻匪於徐州。

translations.literal: That winter he led his army toward Huaiyuan, crossed the border and defeated Nian bandits at Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: That winter he marched toward Huaiyuan, crossed into Xuzhou, and defeated Nian rebels there.

sentences.zh: 漕運總督邵燦疏請留徐州，報允。

translations.literal: Grain Transport Governor Shao Can memorialized requesting he be retained at Xuzhou; approval was reported.
translations.idiomatic: Grain Transport Governor Shao Can asked that he remain at Xuzhou, and the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 七年，偕總兵史榮椿攻永城岳家集，捻首李月先遁，焚其巢，尋以病歸。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, together with brigade general Shi Rongchun he attacked Yuejiaji in Yongcheng; Nian chief Li Yue fled first; their nest was burned; shortly afterward he returned home because of illness.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he and Brigadier Shi Rongchun attacked Yuejiaji in Yongcheng; Nian chief Li Yue escaped, their stronghold was burned, and Guanbao soon went home ill.

sentences.zh: 八年，命率吉林、黑龍江、察哈爾兵千八百赴袁甲三徐州營。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was ordered to lead eighteen hundred troops from Jilin, Heilongjiang, and Chahar to Yuan Jiasan's camp at Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he was ordered to bring eighteen hundred troops from Jilin, Heilongjiang, and Chahar to Yuan Jiasan's Xuzhou camp.

sentences.zh: 九年，會攻澮北捻首曹金斗，破其圩，乘勝擊捻首張寶全，破之。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he jointly attacked Nian chief Cao Jindou north of the Hui River, broke his fortified village, and following victory attacked Nian chief Zhang Baoquan and broke him.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he jointly attacked Nian chief Cao Jindou north of the Hui River, took his fortified village, and then routed Zhang Baoquan.

sentences.zh: 張洛行陷泗州，踞草溝民寨，關保率民團奪圩外砲台，毀其寨，賊分竄，自相踐踏。

translations.literal: Zhang Luoxing captured Sizhou and occupied Caogou civilian stockade; Guanbao led militia to seize the fortified village's outer cannon platforms, destroyed their stockade; the bandits scattered in flight and trampled one another.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhang Luoxing took Sizhou and held the Caogou militia stockade, Guanbao led local militia to seize the outer batteries, destroyed the stronghold, and sent the rebels fleeing over one another.

sentences.zh: 餘賊竄五河雙渡口，奪船爭渡，追殪過半，擒賊目張起等，以副都統記名。

translations.literal: Remaining bandits fled to Shuangdukou in Wuhe, seized boats and competed to cross; pursuit killed more than half; bandit chief Zhang Qi and others were captured; he was entered on the list for vice commandant-general.
translations.idiomatic: Survivors fled to Shuangdukou in Wuhe and fought for boats to cross; pursuit killed more than half and captured chiefs including Zhang Qi; Guanbao was noted for vice commandant-general.

sentences.zh: 命幫辦傅振邦三省剿匪事，斬捻首張添福，進搗任乾畢圩，圩民內應斬乾，餘黨盡殲。

translations.literal: He was ordered to assist Fu Zhenbang in three-province bandit suppression, beheaded Nian chief Zhang Tianfu, advanced to storm Ren Ganbi's fortified village; village people responded from within and beheaded Gan; remaining partisans were entirely annihilated.
translations.idiomatic: Ordered to assist Fu Zhenbang in three-province operations, he beheaded Nian chief Zhang Tianfu, stormed Ren Ganbi's fortified village with inside help that killed Gan, and wiped out the rest.

sentences.zh: 接統伊興額軍，命督辦河南防務，佐振邦剿匪三省如故。

translations.literal: He took over command of Yixing'e's army, was ordered to supervise Henan defense affairs, and assisted Zhenbang in three-province bandit suppression as before.
translations.idiomatic: He assumed command of Yixing'e's troops, was put in charge of Henan defenses, and continued to assist Zhenbang across three provinces.

sentences.zh: 授黑龍江副都統。

translations.literal: He was appointed vice commandant-general of Heilongjiang.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed vice commandant-general of Heilongjiang.

sentences.zh: 破亳州竄匪，捻首孫葵心聚黨永城，圖分竄，詔勿令攔入山東邊境。

translations.literal: He broke bandits fleeing from Bozhou; Nian chief Sun Kuixin gathered partisans at Yongcheng planning to scatter in flight; an edict ordered that they not be allowed to break into the Shandong border.
translations.idiomatic: He routed rebels fleeing from Bozhou; when Nian chief Sun Kuixin gathered forces at Yongcheng to scatter northward, the court ordered that they not be allowed into Shandong.

sentences.zh: 飭關保截賊西路，逼之歸巢。

translations.literal: Guanbao was ordered to intercept the bandits' western route and force them back to their nest.
translations.idiomatic: Guanbao was ordered to block the western line and drive them back to their base.

sentences.zh: 已而賊眾二萬分擾商丘、柘城，圍睢州，開封戒嚴，上命由鹿邑赴援。

translations.literal: Before long a bandit force of twenty thousand divided to harass Shangqiu and Zhecheng, besieged Suizhou; Kaifeng was placed on alert; the emperor ordered him to go from Luyi to reinforce.
translations.idiomatic: Soon twenty thousand rebels raided Shangqiu and Zhecheng and besieged Suizhou; Kaifeng went on alert and the emperor ordered Guanbao to reinforce from Luyi.

sentences.zh: 賊趨蘭儀，分擾通許、尉氏，關保馳抵陳留，合諸軍夾擊，賊南走。

translations.literal: The bandits pressed toward Lanyi, divided to harass Tongxu and Weishi; Guanbao galloped to Chenliu, joined the various armies in pincer attack, and the bandits fled south.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels moved on Lanyi and sent columns against Tongxu and Weishi; Guanbao raced to Chenliu, joined other forces in a pincer, and drove them south.

sentences.zh: 馳援許州，遣副將王鳳翔率騎兵敗賊洪河北岸，又敗之臨潁城下，陣擒葵心親屬孫套。

translations.literal: He galloped to reinforce Xuchang, dispatched vice general Wang Fengxiang to lead cavalry in defeating bandits on the north bank of the Hong River, again defeated them below Linying city, and on the field captured Kuixin's kinsman Sun Tao.
translations.idiomatic: He rushed to Xuchang, sent Vice General Wang Fengxiang to rout the enemy on the north bank of the Hong River, beat them again below Linying, and captured Kuixin's kinsman Sun Tao in battle.

sentences.zh: 夜，簡精騎劫賊營，斬馘無算，拔難民千餘，賊東奔，偵別賊竄扶溝、太康，要擊之王隆集。

translations.literal: At night he selected elite cavalry to raid the bandit camp, beheaded and killed without number, rescued more than a thousand refugees; the bandits fled east; scouting found other bandits fleeing through Fugou and Taikang; he intercepted them at Wanglongji.
translations.idiomatic: By night he sent picked cavalry to raid the camp, killed countless enemies, and freed more than a thousand civilians; when the rebels fled east he learned another band was moving through Fugou and Taikang and ambushed them at Wanglongji.

sentences.zh: 沿途搜捕，豫境肅清。

translations.literal: Searching and capturing along the route, Henan territory was cleared.
translations.idiomatic: Mopping up along the route, he cleared Henan of rebels.

sentences.zh: 十年，命勝保督辦河南軍務，關保仍副之。

translations.literal: In the tenth year Sheng Bao was ordered to supervise Henan military affairs; Guanbao still served as his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year Sheng Bao was put in charge of Henan military affairs, with Guanbao as his deputy.

sentences.zh: 賊擾​​虞、夏邑、鹿邑，遣將擊走之，俄又大至，逼近省垣，詔詰責。

translations.literal: Bandits harassed Yucheng, Xiayi, and Luyi; he dispatched generals to attack and drive them off; soon they came again in great force, pressing close to the provincial capital; an edict censured and reproached.
translations.idiomatic: When rebels raided Yucheng, Xiayi, and Luyi he sent officers to drive them off, but they soon returned in force near the provincial capital and the court rebuked him.

sentences.zh: 尋轉戰汝寧、確山皆捷，分兵破賊鹿邑劉集，解丘集圍。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward he fought successively at Runing and Queshan with all victories; divided troops broke bandits at Liuji in Luyi and lifted the siege of Qiuji.
translations.idiomatic: He then won fights at Runing and Queshan, sent detachments to defeat rebels at Liuji in Luyi, and relieved Qiuji.

sentences.zh: 賊复糾黨來攻，擊走之。

translations.literal: The bandits again rallied partisans to come attack; he attacked and drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebels gathered and attacked again, he beat them back.

sentences.zh: 傷發，予假調理。

translations.literal: His wound broke open; leave was granted for recuperation.
translations.idiomatic: An old wound reopened and he was granted leave to recover.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，赴黑龍江任，八年卒。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi he went to his post in Heilongjiang; in the eighth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tongzhi (1862) he took up his Heilongjiang post and died in the eighth year of Tongzhi (1869).

sentences.zh: 論曰：都興阿雅量寬閎，知兵容眾，胡林翼稱其有豐、鎬故家遺風，當時滿洲諸名將，半出部下。

translations.literal: Commentary says: Du Xing'a's generous capacity was broad and magnanimous; knowing warfare he accommodated men; Hu Linyi praised him as having the lingering style of the old families of Feng and Hao; at that time half of the Manchu famous generals came from among his subordinates.
translations.idiomatic: The commentators say Du Xing'a was magnanimous and broad-minded, skilled in war and tolerant of talent; Hu Linyi said he carried something of the old Zhou aristocratic temper; half the famed Manchu generals of the day had served under him.

sentences.zh: 舒保亦以樸勇為林翼所倚重，及林翼歿，無人善用，倉卒殞寇，世咸惜之。

translations.literal: Shubao too, for his plain honesty and bravery, was relied upon by Linyi; when Linyi died, no one knew how to use him well; in haste he perished at the hands of bandits; the world all regretted it.
translations.idiomatic: Shubao too was valued by Linyi for his plain courage; after Linyi's death no one used him properly, and his sudden death in battle was widely mourned.

sentences.zh: 富明阿始終江北軍事，其勳勞出托明阿、德興阿之上，晚膺邊寄，亦稱賢帥。

translations.literal: Fuming'a from beginning to end handled Jiangbei military affairs; his merit and labor exceeded those of Tuoming'a and Dexing'a; in late years entrusted with frontier duty, he too was called a worthy commander.
translations.idiomatic: Fuming'a directed Jiangbei operations throughout; his record surpassed Tuoming'a and Dexing'a, and in his later frontier assignment he too was judged an able commander.

sentences.zh: 伊興額剿捻盡瘁，最得民心，為驕帥齮齕，未竟其用。

translations.literal: Yixing'e in suppressing the Nian exhausted his utmost, most won the hearts of the people, was nibbled at by arrogant commanders, and did not complete his usefulness.
translations.idiomatic: Yixing'e gave his all against the Nian and won the people's trust, but jealous proud commanders undermined him and his talents were never fully used.

sentences.zh: 關保善將騎，群帥爭相引重，其遭際為獨幸焉。

translations.literal: Guanbao was skilled at leading cavalry; commanders all competed to esteem him; his fortunate appointment was uniquely lucky.
translations.idiomatic: Guanbao was an excellent cavalry commander whom fellow generals eagerly sought; in fortune his career was unusually blessed.
